**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve other L4 violations when a task cannot be read**

If a push contains an invalid criterion move and an unrelated unreadable task blob, `amendment_blob` raises `Cannot` and aborts the entire L4 run, discarding any violations already collected and skipping subsequent tasks. I reproduced this with a bad move in `a.md` followed by a non-UTF-8 `z.md`: the move is reported when checked alone, but disappears from the combined push's output. Because later pushes deliberately do not re-report existing defects, this loses the move's only diagnostic. Accumulate cannot-judge errors per task/commit and preserve known violations, as L3 already does.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Exclude tilde-fenced examples from live criteria**

When `## Acceptance criteria` contains a `~~~md` example with an amendment marker, this call counts the example as a live replacement because `unfenced` recognizes only backtick fences. A moved amendment with an actually unmarked replacement therefore produces no L4 violation. I reproduced the same document returning `('unmarked', 1)` with backticks but no defect with tildes. Use fence handling consistent with `parse_amendments`, which already recognizes both delimiter types, so example declarations cannot satisfy the replacement requirement or create false reused-ID reports.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
